name: Vaultopolis
tagline: Edition analytics, marketplace data, pack tools, and token liquidity across NBA Top Shot, NFL All Day, and Disney Pinnacle — all on Flow blockchain
description: Vaultopolis is a web application providing portfolio analytics, marketplace data, pack tools, and token liquidity for Flow blockchain NFT collectibles — specifically NBA Top Shot (moments), NFL All Day, and Disney Pinnacle. It integrates directly with Flow blockchain via FCL (Flow Client Library) and Cadence smart contracts, and provides a custom TSHOT token for liquidity. Users can view their NFT portfolio, analyze edition data, manage packs, and access token swap functionality. The platform also has an API backend at api.vaultopolis.com.
techStack: FCL (Flow Client Library) — direct on-chain reads
TSHOT token (custom Flow token for liquidity)

designNotes.colorPalette: Dark theme (bg-brand-secondary/95 with backdrop-blur) — dark navy/charcoal primary background, white/light brand text. 'brand-secondary' and 'brand-text' CSS variables detected. Backdrop blur with 10% white border (border-white/10) suggests glassmorphism elements. Shadow-2xl and shadow-black/40 for depth.
designNotes.typography: Inter (variable font, Google Fonts, opsz 14..32, wght 100..900) — clean, data-focused, modern sans-serif. Appropriate for financial/analytics dashboard.
designNotes.layout: Web app dashboard rather than marketing site. Fixed sidebar or top navigation. Heavy data tables, card grids, and analytics panels. Modal overlays (large responsive modal: 95vw max-w-7xl, 85vh). Toasts for notifications. Responsive breakpoints: sm:w-[400px] → md:w-[440px] → lg:w-[480px].
designNotes.heroSection: Application shell — no traditional marketing hero. Users log in via Flow wallet (FCL auth) to see their portfolio. Likely shows a dashboard with collection overview, tier counts, TSHOT balance, and pack status on first authenticated view.

collectionSupport: NBA Top Shot (moments, sets, plays, serial numbers, locking status, subeditions)
NFL All Day (editions, sets, plays, series, tiers)

userFlow: Connect Flow wallet (or login with email OTP) → View your NBA Top Shot / NFL All Day / Disney Pinnacle NFT portfolio → Analyze edition data (serial numbers, tier, set/play metadata) → Check pack status and open packs → Access TSHOT token liquidity tools → Track marketplace data and edition analytics across collections.
valueProposition: Gives Flow blockchain NFT collectors a unified analytics platform that the official NBA Top Shot / NFL All Day apps don't provide — deep edition statistics, cross-collection portfolio view, pack management, and DeFi liquidity via TSHOT. Fills the gap between 'I own these NFTs' and 'I understand what they're worth and how to trade them efficiently.'
businessModel: Free web application (no paywalled features detected). Revenue likely from: TSHOT token mechanics (spread/fees on swaps), potential future premium analytics, or ecosystem/partnership arrangements with Dapper Labs/Flow Foundation. Uses Umami (privacy-first analytics) suggesting they care about user trust. Google Analytics 4 also present.
strengths: Deep Flow blockchain integration — reads Cadence contracts directly via FCL, not just API wrappers
Covers all three major Flow NFT platforms (NBA Top Shot + NFL All Day + Disney Pinnacle) in one app
TSHOT token creates a proprietary liquidity layer and DeFi angle beyond pure analytics
Privacy-conscious analytics choice (Umami) signals trust-oriented product values
API backend (api.vaultopolis.com) enables scalable data serving beyond direct blockchain reads
Subedition support for NBA Top Shot shows deep domain expertise
WebSocket/subscription support for real-time block data (block subscription detected in source)
weaknesses: Niche market — limited to Flow blockchain NFT collectors (NBA Top Shot / NFL All Day / Disney Pinnacle fans)
No marketing page — landing page is effectively the app itself, high barrier for non-crypto users
Flow blockchain ecosystem has contracted significantly since 2021-2022 peak
Disney Pinnacle was shut down in early 2025 — one of three supported platforms may be dead
No demo video or screenshots on landing page — new users have no idea what they're getting into
TSHOT exchange mechanics (grailExchange, goatExchange) are unclear from public documentation
Single Twitter social link — limited community presence compared to Discord-native NFT communities
lessonsForPCC: Vaultopolis's core architectural lesson for PCC is the FCL pattern: reading blockchain state directly in the client via typed Cadence queries, not proxying everything through a backend API. PCC's viem-based contract reads could adopt a similar 'blockchain as source of truth, UI as renderer' model where the dashboard directly queries on-chain job state rather than relying on a backend cache. Their TSHOT liquidity layer — creating a fungible token that represents value in the ecosystem — maps to PCC's potential USDC/ERC-20 payment token design for capability credits. The receipt system (betAmount receipts for pending swaps) is an elegant pattern for PCC's escrow-pending-verification state. Most importantly: Vaultopolis shows that building deep vertical expertise in one chain's data model creates a defensible niche — PCC should similarly go deep on Base's event/log data for capability verification rather than trying to be chain-agnostic.
